dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product holds sets of its own items — rows, tiles, cards, files — in a column, a line or a wrapping grid, with or without space and lines between them; lets people open them one by one or choose from them, some selected and some disabled; and lets people drag the items of one such set into another order.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a list reads: the three gaps between its items and the divider between them; for an item that is an action, a link or an option, its minimum height, paddings and gap, the text style and the color it hands its content, the glyph box of the check (the icon set's check), and for each condition (unselected, selected) the colors of the box and its content in each state. For a reorderable list: the fill and the elevation of an item while it is dragged, and the motion of items changing place.
rules: The list adds no space around its items and draws no background: place it on a surface, or in a card for a grouped look. Its items are the product's content; a static item draws nothing of its own.
A selectable list is a listbox; a list whose items each open something has interactive items or link items; a list that only shows things has neither.
Never put a button, link or control inside an interactive item, a link item or an option; an item that needs its own control stays static.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.
The check of a selected option is the icon set's check glyph, drawn at mark.size; to draw another mark, a system chooses another icon set. Never draw a check of your own.
Each condition's state-layer.color is the color hover, focus and press mix into the item; it aliases that condition's content color.

A reorderable list holds static items only and is never a listbox. Its handle is a Tanrei Button and its move menu a Tanrei Menu, drawn from their own tokens. The dragged tokens are a look of one item while it is carried, not an interaction state: no state rule values them.

shape.$description: The corners of an item that is an action, a link or an option, and of a dragged item. Square by default: items meet edge to edge.

height.$description: The minimum height of an item that is an action, a link or an option. A minimum: the item grows with its content and with enlarged text.

padding-inline-start.$description: Space between the start edge of an item that is an action, a link or an option and its content; it lines the content up with the page's.

padding-inline-end.$description: Space between the content (or the check) of such an item and its end edge.

padding-block.$description: Space above and below the content of such an item; it shows once the content is taller than the minimum height.

gap.$description: Space between an item's content and the parts the list draws beside it: the check of an option, the mark of a link that opens a new context, the handle of a reorderable item.

typescale.$description: The text style an item that is an action, a link or an option hands its content: text the product did not style takes it.

gap.$description: The space between two neighbouring items, and between two lines of a wrapping list, by the gap value (none: touching).

size.$description: The glyph box of the check (the icon set's check) of a selected option, reserved in every option of a selectable list: a glyph's ink fills less of its box than a drawn path of that size.

width.$description: The stroke of the check drawn as a path. No behaviour of the current spec reads it: the check is a glyph of the icon set (LST-21). It stays only so that the platforms that still draw it as a path keep building; remove it in the commit that brings the last of them up to date.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: An item has no fill at rest; the surface behind the list shows through.

color.$description: The foreground an item that is an action, a link or an option hands its content: the color of text and glyphs the product did not color.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: An option that is not selected shows no check.

color.$description: The color hover, focus and press mix into the item: its content's color.

The fill of a selected option, drawn over whatever the list stands on and under the item's content (LST-25). The role named here is the quiet selection's; the default system does not draw that tone — it values this token as a layer of the item's own content color (selected.state-layer.color at the selected layer, sys.state.selected-state-layer-opacity: 16 %, twice the hover layer: tokens/systems/tanrei.system.json), as the menu values its checked row, so that the fill is seen by the same step on whatever the surface is and stands apart from a hovered item. A design system that sets this token draws what it sets. The check is always drawn with the fill; the fill never carries the choice alone.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the item: its content's color.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

reorder-duration.$description: How long an item takes to change place: the items that slide aside under a dragged one, the dropped item settling, an item lifted by the keyboard stepping to its next place, and items changing places after a move (LST-38, LST-41). Longer than a change of color: something crosses the length of an item.

color.$description: The fill of an item while it is dragged, under its content. Opaque, where a static item has no fill: the item is carried over the others and they must not show through it.

elevation.$description: The shadow of an item while it is dragged: it is above the list for as long as it is carried, and comes down when it is dropped.
